description: This file contains test utility functions for React components, including a custom render method with context providers and a mock function for navigation, used in testing scenarios within the frontend project.

methods.name: renderWithProviders
methods.description: Renders a React component wrapped with the AppProvider for testing with state context.

methods.name: mockNextNavigation
methods.description: A no-op function that indicates mock setup for Next.js navigation; previously wrapped mocks, now centrally handled.
